name: Demon Seed
source:
Demon Seed is a story-driven adult Visual Novel, filled with super natural mystery, comedy and lots of steamy, passionate sex. Unravel the secrets of a long-forgotten heritage and explore your awakening powers. Build intimate relationships with a diverse cast of stunning women and grow your harem.

[From [url=https://buff-games.itch.io/demon-seed]itch.io[/url]]
